headline: Shrubclaw Worker
title: Shrubclaw | Top early Homeland worker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Need an early Homeland worker in Aniimo? Shrubclaw is a standout. It has Earth three, Grass two and Hauling three, so one Aniimo covers mining, planting and carrying. It evolves from Budclaw, taking the Shrubclaw branch. Guides say a Playful personality speeds up mining by twenty percent. Put it on the mines. Remember a working Aniimo cannot join your battle team. Do you use Shrubclaw? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Shrubclaw guide: Earth 3, Grass 2 and Hauling 3 make it a top early Homeland worker, evolved from Budclaw.
